sources.title: 【ABF載板】欣興(3037)獲得NVIDIA出貨認證，對整體PCB產業的影響
sources.effective_period: The article reports a global share of about 18% for IC substrates; it does not specify that this is ABF-only share.
sources.note: Reputable secondary analysis. It describes Unimicron as the second-largest global IC-substrate maker and gives approximately 18% global share, but the stated denominator is not expressly ABF.

sources.title: 〔投資研究報告〕 ABF 載板崛起-引領半導體革命的隱形推手
sources.effective_period: Report discusses the 2024 global ABF-substrate market.
sources.locator: Section 3, Unimicron Technology Corporation, “全球市占與客戶黏著度”
sources.note: Investment-research report states Unimicron was the second-largest ABF substrate supplier at about 24%, behind Ibiden. Its figure conflicts with treating 18% as ABF share.

sources.title: 〔投資研究報告〕 ABF 載板崛起-引領半導體革命的隱形推手
sources.effective_period: Report discusses the 2024 global ABF-substrate market.
sources.locator: Section 3, Unimicron Technology Corporation, “全球市占與客戶黏著度”
sources.note: Explicitly states Unimicron is the second-largest ABF substrate supplier and Ibiden is first.

sources.title: 【ABF載板】欣興(3037)獲得NVIDIA出貨認證，對整體PCB產業的影響
sources.effective_period: NVIDIA B100 qualification reported in 2024; customer list is not tied to a stated period.
sources.note: Names Intel, AMD, Apple, and Nvidia as customers and reports Unimicron as the second qualified supplier after Ibiden for NVIDIA B100 ABF substrates. The article attributes the qualification information to a U.S. brokerage report.

sources.title: ABF三雄外資力挺！野村將欣興喊上270元太瘋狂？分析師：手握四優勢無敵了
sources.effective_period: Nomura analyst view reported for 2025–2026; AMD server-CPU supply relationship described as beginning in H2 2024.
sources.locator: Article text, paragraph beginning “野村證券科技產業分析師李佳伶指出”
sources.note: Reports Unimicron as an AMD server-CPU substrate key supplier since H2 2024 and describes NVIDIA-related ABF share and supply relationships for named products.

sources.title: ABF需求長線無虞！欣興搭上NVIDIA＋Intel黃金列車
sources.effective_period: Describes the Intel EMIB relationship as of September 2025.
sources.note: Reports that Unimicron has long supplied Intel EMIB substrates and that the companies jointly invested in a Yangmei facility.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
已達本輪可用研究與工具迭代上限。市占率數字的ABF專屬分母、測量口徑及原始統計來源仍未釐清。
查得的18%數字出自2024年二級資料對整體IC載板市場的描述，不能直接當作ABF載板市占率。
2025年投資研究報告所述ABF市占約24%，未提供足以在此核實的計算方法；不同市場口徑可能造成差異。
欣興的客戶與供應商關係證據主要來自媒體及券商／投資研究轉述，不是欣興對所列客戶逐一確認的官方披露。
